=====================================
Cyan Blue Neon Arcade UI Pack – README
=====================================

Author : Uryon Games  
Format : PNG (+ optional .px source files)  
Resolution :
- Icons : 64x64
- Small buttons : 150x64
- Medium buttons : 256x64
- Large buttons : 300x64
Exported at 4x scale for clean pixel-perfect rendering.
Color theme : Cyan blue neon / retro arcade pixel-art style  
Optimal backgrounds : #000000 (black), #020A16 (midnight blue), #0A0A0A (dark grey)

---------------------------------------
CONTENTS (Total : 20+ UI Elements)
---------------------------------------

1) LABELED BUTTONS  
- Back  
- Continue  
- Exit  
- No  
- Ok  
- Options  
- Pause  
- Play  
- Resume  
- Retry  
- Start  

2) ICON BUTTONS  
- Settings icon  
- Sound On icon  
- Sound Off icon  
- Arrow Left  
- Arrow Right  
- Arrow Up  
- Arrow Down  

3) FORMATS  
- PNG ready for Unity, Godot, Unreal, GameMaker, Construct, etc.  
- .px source files included (editable for color changes, text edits, or custom resizing)

----------------
HOW TO USE
----------------
1. Import the PNG files into your engine of choice.  
2. Use the “Medium” buttons for primary UI navigation,  
   the “Small” buttons for confirmation dialogs,  
   the “Large” buttons for main menu titles,  
   and the 64x64 icons for HUD or settings panels.  
3. (Optional) Modify colors, labels, borders, or glow intensity using  
   the included .px source files to match your game’s style.  
4. For best visual results, place the UI on a **dark background**:  
   - #000000 : strong neon contrast  
   - #020A16 : soft sci-fi glow  
   - #0A0A0A : subtle arcade ambience
